_comment: Plant-care metafield definitions used by the theme. Created by setup/setup-store.mjs, or by hand in Settings → Custom data → Products. Choice lists power the storefront filters and the plant-finder quiz — keep values identical to the quiz option values.

product.name: Botanical name
product.description: Latin name incl. cultivar, e.g. Dionaea muscipula 'B52'. Shown in italics on cards and the product page.

product.name: Water
product.description: e.g. Rain, distilled or RO water only. Tray method, 1–2 cm deep.

product.name: Dormancy
product.description: e.g. Required — cool winter rest, Jun–Aug

product.name: Needs winter dormancy
product.description: Shows the dormancy-season notice on the product page (Theme settings → Live plant shipping).

product.name: Care guide link
product.description: Link to the matching care-guide blog post.

collection.name: Care guide link
collection.description: Shown under the collection title, e.g. the Venus flytrap care guide.

article.name: Plants in this guide
article.description: Adds a 'Plants in this guide' product row under the article.
